items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith expected to be charged with war crimes
items.description: One of Australia's most decorated soldiers, Ben Roberts-Smith, has been arrested and is expected to be charged with five counts of the war crime of murder.

items.title: EV sales surge as fuel anxiety clears auctions, showrooms in Australia
items.description: EV sales have surged in March, a month into the war in Iran. But it is not the only signal indicating a move away from fuel cars.

items.title: Coke bottles to a 200L drum: Petrol stations see dangerous fuel stockpiling
items.description: Authorities are warning that improper or excessive storage of petrol or diesel in suburban homes carries a significant fire risk, as service station owners report excessive stockpiling.

items.title: Mixed results for tourism sector over Easter amid fuel price surge
items.description: It was a mixed weekend for many tourism businesses across the country, amid fears rising fuel costs would keep people home. For some it was business as usual, but fuel uncertainty has many in the sector feeling nervous about the months ahead.

items.title: Trump's shifting Iran war rhetoric is working against his credibility
items.description: Donald Trump's increasingly erratic language means that a US president's word — which would have once been regarded with gravitas — holds perhaps only the same weight as the word of the "evil" regime he says he has obliterated several times.

items.title: Artemis II reveals previously unseen far side of the Moon
items.description: The astronauts have travelled further from Earth than any humans before, capturing never-before-seen views of the far side of the Moon.

items.title: 'MAGA for Mamdani': The issue flipping Trump voters to a left-wing Democrat
items.description: US President Donald Trump and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani are from polar opposite ends of the political spectrum, but comic Ron Barba voted for them both.

items.title: Live: PM reports 'fewer' petrol shortages as Trump pressures Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran "could be taken out in one night, and that night might be tomorrow night" in his latest press conference. Follow live.

items.title: Trump threatens 'demolition' of Iran and takes another swipe at Australia
items.description: Donald Trump says the "entire country" of Iran will be "taken out" if no deal is reached by Wednesday morning (AEST), ratcheting up his threat to target civilian infrastructure and brushing off concerns it would be a war crime.

items.title: Rohan Dennis speaks publicly for the first time since Melissa Hoskins's death
items.description: Former professional cyclist Rohan Dennis has spoken publicly for the first time about the death of his wife Melissa Hoskins, saying he and his children have since been "harassed" and "stalked" by the media.

items.title: Ex-Bondi nanny fails in bid to avoid extradition over Chilean kidnapping claims
items.description: A former Bondi nanny accused of torture and kidnapping for the Chilean Pinochet regime loses her final legal bid to avoid extradition to Chile.

items.title: Cyclist clinging to reeds, pulled to safety in remote Snowy River rescue
items.description: The cyclist was clinging to reeds in the middle of the Snowy River when the police air wing pulled them to safety.

items.title: Live: ASX up 1.3pc after modest gains on Wall St as Iran deadline looms
items.description: The Australian share market is up 1.35pc after a four-day long weekend, as traders appear to look through the ongoing uncertainty in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Grow up': Meta censoring warnings about illicit drugs, health experts say
items.description: Public health workers are warning lives could be at risk due to social media sites automatically censoring educational posts about illicit drugs circulating in the community.

items.title: I am tired of constantly defending being single and child-free
items.description: I might be on a different path, but I can still love and be loved in ways that don't require me to be a mother or a partner.

items.title: Vegan leather sounds eco‑friendly but the truth is complex
items.description: As fashion brands move away from animal leather, "vegan" has come to suggest something that is both kinder to animals and better for the planet. However, the reality is more complicated.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: As Indians queue for cooking gas, a black market is growing
items.description: Across Delhi, people are waiting days and sometimes weeks for gas cylinders. Yet, the ABC has found a thriving black market, where the same gas can be bought quickly — for those who can afford it.

items.title: Trump threatens to jail journalist who broke story of US rescue mission in Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump is threatening to jail the journalist who broke the story about the rescue of a downed US airman in Iran, as more details about the daring recovery mission are made public.

items.title: Rapper Offset hospitalised after shooting in Florida
items.description: The Migos rapper is in a stable condition though his exact condition is unknown, according to his spokesperson.

items.title: Pheobe Bishop murder-accused to face court on anniversary of 17yo's disappearance
items.description: The case of a woman accused of murdering Queensland teenager Pheobe Bishop has been adjourned to May 15 — the first anniversary of Pheobe's disappearance.

items.title: Gambling reforms bill slammed as 'kneejerk' response to Four Corners
items.description: The Northern Territory government has introduced legislation intended to reform Australia's de facto online gambling regulator, but it's been criticised as a "damage-control exercise".

items.title: Tech starts to eat itself as AI reshapes workforce
items.description: The wave of change from artificial intelligence rolling across the corporate landscape is going largely unnoticed as attention understandably shifts to an escalating war.

items.title: Man sent home from hospital with '10/10' pain ends up losing chunk of leg
items.description: An Australian Navy candidate says he nearly lost his leg following delays in diagnosis and treatment of his emergency condition by two Perth hospitals.

items.title: Woman's 'suspicious' death investigated after car allegedly hit by kangaroo
items.description: NT Police are investigating the "suspicious death" of a woman on a remote stretch of highway in the early hours of Easter morning.
